value.subject: Preschool Swim start for Ada
value.body:
Hello,

I'm hoping to enroll my child Ada in Preschool Swim, and I would love for her to start in January. I see that your site currently offers sessions starting November 21 and November 28, as well as a waitlist for a session starting January 9, 2027.

Could you let me know whether Ada can start in January instead of one of the November sessions, and if the January waitlist is the best way to secure a spot? Any guidance on how likely a space is to open up would be much appreciated.

Thank you so much for your help.
